concerns.text: FR-011 generates the request trace using Cluster IDs derived from community detection on the *Proxy Graph*, which itself is constructed from the raw cosine‑similarity overlap matrix (FR-014). The same Proxy Graph is later used by the Topological Lookahead scheduling policy (US‑4) as its predictor. Because the workload (validation target) is created from the predictor, the evaluation of the policy is not independent – it is circular/tautological. This violates the requirement that validation outcomes be independent of the quantities used to construct the metric.
